evidence.title: Quantum Reservoir Computing with Physics-Informed Correction for Reduced-Order PDE Forecasting

summary: Researchers introduce a quantum reservoir computing method enhanced by physics-informed correction to improve the accuracy of reduced-order partial differential equation (PDE) forecasting. The approach leverages quantum computing to address complex dynamical systems more efficiently.
title: Quantum Reservoir Computing Advances Reduced-Order PDE Forecasting with Physics-Informed Correction
